Membership status and billing

Your Franklin membership lives here.

After Stripe checkout returns, Franklin confirms the payment event, records the durable membership and entitlement, and shows the current status here. If activation is still processing, do not pay again.

Payment returned but status is still processing?

Do not make a second payment. Stripe webhooks and Franklin’s durable membership ledger may take a few seconds to finish. Refresh this page shortly or contact member support if the status does not update.

Need billing controls?

Once an active membership is linked to your account, use Manage billing here to open the account-bound Stripe Customer Portal.
